answer: Island mooring bonds stop fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits on the onyx ledger for an island berth, filing an anchor claim. Auditors draw 5% of berths each epoch and demand an anchor reading; drift past 2% or reuse burns the bond. One operator cannot sign two berths in one window, so rented anchors fail: one key ties both to one audit. First 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once.
